description: Truncates user messages exceeding the configured character limit and prepends a system notice so both sides know content was cut. When OFF, messages pass through uncapped. One enforcement point covers normal chat and genui dispatches.

settings.label: Maximum message length (characters)
settings.hint: Messages exceeding this length are truncated with a system notice prepended so the agent and user know content was cut. The default is 8,000 characters.
